title: How Brands Become Icons
subtitle: The Principles of Cultural Branding

verification.method: Web check of title/author/publisher/year against publisher or library records
verification.notes: Originally published by Harvard Business School Press (September 2004); the imprint is now Harvard Business Review Press and some retailer records use the later name.

summary: Cultural branding theory: iconic brands win by performing identity myths that resolve cultural contradictions of their era, a fundamentally different mechanism than mindshare models.
